notes.text: - **IRDP, TRYSEM and NREP** = all for eradication of rural poverty; **NREP and RLEGP** both in the **6th Plan**; IRDP is the programme of the **Sixth Plan** (1980).

q: Which one of the following is not a part of the strategy of direct attack on poverty ?
explanation: Family Planning is a population-control measure, not a direct attack on poverty like IRDP, JRY or NREP.

notes.text: - **"Direct attack on poverty"** = IRDP, NREP, RLEGP, JRY (target-group approach); **Family Planning** is a population measure, NOT direct attack.

exam: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
q: The target population of the National Rural Employment Programme was?
options: Rural wage workers who did not have employment in non-agricultural season
Rural Men and women landless labour only
Rural cultivators who were in debt trap
key_text: Rural wage workers who did not have employment in non-agricultural season
explanation: NREP (1980) gave wage employment to rural workers in the lean, non-agricultural season, building community assets; it was not limited to women, landless men and women, or indebted cultivators. (Wage-employment programme; moved.)
